title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Tariff Clause: Amount of the Tow Notice Fee
content:
**Tariff clause.** The tow notice fee on a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement is the tow notice fee of the space class shown in the collections timetable, charged once for the notice, never below zero, and rounded to the cent.

**Reading the clause.**
- *Which figure.* The figure is that of the agreement's own space class.
- *How often.* Once for each notice of intent to tow; a single notice carries a single fee.
- *What it is not.* It is not a share of the rent or of the balance due; the amount does not move with either.

**Hypothetical illustrations.**

| Agreement | Class tow notice fee | Tow notice fee |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space, rent $95.00, balance due $230.00 | $40.00 | $40.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft), rent $410.00, balance due $1,105.00 | $50.00 | $50.00 |
